content_of_post_to_comment: You feel depressed and crazy because in every historical human culture known to anthropology, people sang together, danced together, and ate food together- and you don't sing, you don't dance, and you eat alone in the dark. You are a singing ape, and you are meant to know fifty dances by heart, which hilltops are sacred, and the names of every plant it is possible to eat. - Jay LeSoleil
comment: The interesting tension is that modern isolation isn't just a lack of community, but a loss of shared rituals. Rebuilding connection may require creating new traditions, not simply returning to old ones.
